text: The panda, with its distinctive and luxuriant black and white fur, is a herviborous bear adapted to life in bamboo forests. The average giant panda eats as much as 9 to 14 kg of bamboo shoots a day to compensate for the limited energy content of its diet. Pandas are generally less agressive than other bear species.\n\n<color=#33d733>Real World Conservation Status:</color> Vulnerable. Recently upgraded from endangered status (as of 2020), wild panda numbers are finally rebounding after years of decline. Habitat loss is their main threat.
